annotations.title: Calendar reminder for the last safe day to cancel

description: Calendar reminder for the last safe day to cancel. Returns a calendar file (.ics) with an all-day event on the cancel-by day, the steps and the official link, with alerts at 9am the day before and 9am on the day. Nothing is stored. get_cancel_steps gives this link as add_to_calendar whenever renews_on is given and the day hasn't passed.

country.description: Two-letter country code. GB (or UK) gives UK pages, UK notice rules and uk_rules; defaults to the caller's country, else US.

renews_on.description: Next renewal or billing date, YYYY-MM-DD.
